QUOTE: "Define `MBEDTLS_PLATFORM_MEMORY` in the config, plus `MBEDTLS_PLATFORM_CALLOC_MACRO` and `MBEDTLS_PLATFORM_FREE_MACRO`" / "call: mbedtls_platform_set_calloc_free(my_calloc, my_free);"
VERDICT: MISS
WHY: The answer describes both a compile-time macro pair and a runtime function-pointer pair, but it never says they are mutually exclusive. It describes the runtime layer as active only when the macros are not supplied, which hedges toward exclusivity, and it also says to "keep MBEDTLS_PLATFORM_MEMORY set". It flags that reading as unconfirmed.
